name: Tempester n°1: dump requests (sound 40, beat 41), identity on the set cable
explanation: See patch/dump_request.asm. The replies go out on the cable set in System ([address]). The beat dump assumes patch n°2a ([routine] frame at 4.2 KB).

commands.F0 01 28 40 F7: current sound ; reply F0 01 28 60 <128 packed bytes> F7
commands.F0 01 28 41 F7: current beat ; reply F0 01 28 5F <beat> F7 (like the menu export)
commands.F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7: identity ; reply … 02 7F F7 (version 0x7F2), on the set cable

excluded.42 project: [routine] (4.1 KB) + [routine] (4.2 KB): ~8.9 KB of stack out of 9.9; shrink its buffer first
